name: E-senpai
source:
A friendly third-year student who loves history.
The oldest son in a family of rice farmers.
His mannerisms and way of thinking are strangely old-fashioned.
While he's normally an interesting boy with an abundance of conversation topics, when it comes to the Bakumatsu era, national defense and food rations he tends to derail.
